name: sysfnos
description: Self-hosted infrastructure and AI upstream monitoring for NAS deployments

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @sysfnos/server" "npm run dev -w @sysfnos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sysfnos/web && npm run build -w @sysfnos/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sysfnos/server && npm run test -w @sysfnos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sysfnos/server && npm run typecheck -w @sysfnos/web
